Let \(x_v\in\{0,1\}\) indicate whether \(v\in A\). The edge parity is the quadratic form over \(\mathbb F_2\)
\[
q(x)=\sum_{\{u,v\}\in E(\Gamma)}x_u x_v .
\]
The required number is
\[
\frac{2^{25}+S}{2},\qquad
S=\sum_{x\in\mathbb F_2^{25}}(-1)^{q(x)}.
\]

The polar form is
\[
B(x,y)=q(x+y)+q(x)+q(y),
\]
whose matrix is the adjacency matrix of the toroidal grid over \(\mathbb F_2\). If we write a function on the vertices as \(f(i,j)\), then \(f\) lies in the radical exactly when
\[
f(i+1,j)+f(i-1,j)+f(i,j+1)+f(i,j-1)=0.
\]
All functions of the form
\[
f(i,j)=a_{i+j}+b_{i-j}
\]
satisfy this, and these give dimension \(5+5-1=9\). Conversely, using fifth-root Fourier modes, the zero eigenvalue condition is
\[
\alpha+\alpha^{-1}=\beta+\beta^{-1},
\]
which gives \(1+4+4=9\) modes, so the radical has dimension \(9\). Thus \(\operatorname{rank}B=25-9=16\).

For \(f(i,j)=a_{i+j}+b_{i-j}\), the horizontal and vertical edge contributions cancel in pairs modulo \(2\), so \(q(f)=0\) on the whole radical. Therefore
\[
S=2^9 S_0,
\]
where \(S_0\) is the quadratic Gauss sum on a nondegenerate \(16\)-dimensional quotient.

It remains to determine its sign. The nonzero quotient splits into four \(4\)-dimensional blocks. Two are the row-constant and column-constant zero-sum blocks; on either block the form is
\[
h(x)=\sum_{i\in\mathbb Z/5}x_i x_{i+1},\qquad \sum_i x_i=0.
\]
Among the \(16\) even-weight vectors of length \(5\), the signed sum is
\[
1+(5-5)-5=-4.
\]
So each of these two blocks contributes sign \(-\).

The remaining mixed part splits into two analogous \(4\)-dimensional Frobenius blocks. On such a block, with coordinate \(c\in\mathbb F_{16}\), the form is
\[
q(c)=c^5+c^{10}.
\]
For \(c\ne0\), \(c^5\in\mathbb F_4^\times\). Five nonzero \(c\)’s have \(c^5=1\), giving \(q=0\), and ten have \(c^5\ne1\), giving \(q=1\). Including \(c=0\), the signed sum is again
\[
6-10=-4.
\]
Thus the four \(4\)-dimensional blocks contribute
\[
(-4)^4=2^8,
\]
so
\[
S=2^9\cdot 2^8=2^{17}.
\]

Hence the number of subsets with an even number of induced edges is
\[
\frac{2^{25}+2^{17}}2
=2^{24}+2^{16}
=16842752.
\]

\[
\boxed{16842752}
\]
